daemon-window-drag.description: The main window has no title bar, so the daemon's web UI moves it from its `data-tauri-drag-region` top bars. Only start-dragging: no double-click zoom, no other window control, no app commands. Preview windows (`preview-<n>`) are not listed.

shell-pages.description: The bundled splash/error/update pages may call the shell commands and drag the title-bar-less window. No `remote` entry: the daemon's http://127.0.0.1 origin gets no IPC access beyond `daemon-window-drag`. No updater plugin permissions: updates are driven from Rust only.
